title: check/status: report which endorsements come from outside the kernel graph
description: DESIGN (How trust maps) argues a cross-community endorsement is valuable because an attacker must infiltrate two social graphs. That only helps if verifiers can see which endorsements are cross-community. Add it to output: for each person (git vouch status <handle>, and check's per-person line or a report subcommand), mark endorsements whose endorser has no tier and lists alsoKnownAs identities elsewhere, or more strictly is not connected to the anchors through tier grants. Pick the definition first; it must come from the registry alone, offline (no foreign-registry lookups, no federation). From external review 2026-11-15.
